subject: Geo-bind validation and execution plan for Dedicated - FinSecure
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@finsecure.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@finsecure.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Geo-bind validation and execution plan for Dedicated - FinSecure

Hi Alicia / Rajiv,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is our proposed execution plan for the region-pin validation on the Dedicated tenancy we provisioned for FinSecure. The ZIP includes: pin-test-plan.pdf (step-by-step runbook), network-seg-diagram.png (tenant routing + egress controls), and a template wipe-log-sample.csv we’ll collect during the test.

High-level asks from your side before we run:
- Confirm legal/compliance constraints on snapshot retention and backups (any regulatory hold windows).
- Confirm the list of FinSecure participants who will sign the test statement (we’ll need a primary approver).
- Are you available for a 2-hour test window on July 11 or July 12 (your preference)?

Planned checks during the test:
1) Verify all production tenant data paths are pinned to the selected us-west region and that routing to other regions is blocked at the load-balancer layer.
2) Create an ephemeral test tenant, ingest sample records, run a controlled purge, and collect wipe logs and KV-cache tombstones.
3) Validate backups/snapshots are not replicated out-of-region and confirm encryption keys are region-bound.
4) Run a simulated evacuation to confirm no snapshots leave region.

Please review the attached plan and let us know any must-have artifacts for your audit team. If anything in the runbook looks off, flag it and Mina and I will update.

Best,
Michael
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[m] +1-415-555-0192

From: Alicia Park <alicia@finsecure.com>

Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Geo-bind validation and execution plan for Dedicated - FinSecure

Michael — thanks for the detailed plan and attachments. A few initial clarifications from our compliance side: 

- Backups: we need explicit confirmation that automated backups and manual snapshots are retained only in the pinned region (us-west) and are not asynchronously replicated to other regions for any reason. We also need to understand any scheduled cross-region disaster recovery jobs that might exist in your infra.
- Retention/Legal Hold: For certain datasets we may have a 90-day legal hold requirement. How will that interact with the automated purge you describe?
- Evidence format: our auditors prefer wipe logs that include timestamp, object id, deletion cause (api/manual/retention), and a cryptographic hash of the tombstoned object. Can you produce that format?

We can provide a list of two signatories for the test statement (myself and Rajiv). July 11 is preferred; can we target a 14:00–16:00 PT slot? Please confirm the test owner and who at Redwood will be running each step so we can roster our engineers.

Thanks,
Alicia Park
Head of Security Operations, FinSecure
[attachment: finsecure-audit-guidelines.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@finsecure.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@finsecure.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jul 2028 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Geo-bind validation and execution plan for Dedicated - FinSecure

Alicia — great questions. Quick answers below and notes on adjustments we’ll make to the runbook: 

- Backups: Redwood Dedicated is configured for region-bound snapshot storage by default for this tenant. No asynchronous cross-region snapshot replication is enabled for the FinSecure tenant. We will add an explicit verification step to the plan that queries snapshot metadata to show physical storage locations (we’ll capture the AZ/region identifier and storage class).

- Legal hold vs automated purge: the test will exercise the tenant purge path using test data only. For production datasets subject to legal hold, our control plane will mark those objects with a retention tag and they will be excluded from automated purge flows — we’ll document the exact tag semantics in the plan.

- Evidence format: we can produce wipe logs with the fields you requested (timestamp, object_id, deletion_cause, hash). Mina will attach a CSV schema example to the runbook.

We’ll reserve July 11, 14:00–16:00 PT. Proposed roles:
- Redwood test lead: Ben Carter (will execute the purge and collect logs)
- Redwood infra lead: Mina Haddad (will run snapshot metadata checks and validate region bindings)
- FinSecure test approver: Alicia Park / Rajiv Menon

Ben and Mina — can you confirm? I’ll publish a final runbook once you confirm and share a DocuSign statement for signature.

Regards,
Michael
[attachment: network-seg-diagram.png (png, 330KB)]

On Tue, Jul 5, 2028 at 12:30 PM Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com> wrote:
> We’ll reserve July 11, 14:00–16:00 PT. Proposed roles:
> - Redwood test lead: Ben Carter (will execute the purge and collect logs)
> - Redwood infra lead: Mina Haddad (will run snapshot metadata checks and validate region bindings)

Confirmed — Ben and I are good for the slot. A few technical notes I added to the runbook: 

- Pre-test checklist (to be completed 24 hours in advance):
  * Snapshot freeze window confirmed
  * Vault/KMS access validated for the region-only CMK (we will log KMS key IDs used)
  * Monitoring hooks enabled to capture disk IO and network egress metrics during the test

- Purge execution details:
  * Purge will mark records with a tombstone then run the asynchronous background sweeper. We will record the tombstone creation timestamp and the sweeper completion timestamp.
  * Wipe log fields: iso_timestamp, object_id, deletion_cause, tombstone_hash, sweep_completed (true/false), sweep_duration_seconds

- Snapshots: we’ll add a verification command output sample to the runbook that includes storage location (e.g., s3://redwood-us-west-2/tenant-1234/snapshots/).

I attached a sample CSV (wipe-log-sample.csv) that follows the schema above. If FinSecure requires an additional HMAC over the CSV for tamper evidence we can generate that as well.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Infrastructure Reliability, Redwood Inference
[attachment: wipe-log-sample.csv (csv, 4KB)]

Thanks — that addresses most of our compliance questions. Two final asks before we sign off: 

1) Artifact list we need after the test: wipe logs (CSV), snapshot metadata export (JSON), network egress report for the test window, KMS key usage logs, and a short runbook attestation from Redwood describing the steps executed and the results.
2) We require the runbook attestation to be signed (DocuSign will suffice). Please send the DocuSign link for the test attestation and we’ll get it back signed by July 8 EOD.

If you can include an HMAC over the CSV and a storage location where we can download artifacts (limited TTL pre-signed URL preferred), that would be ideal.
